answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Scoring. Each identity's action vector is compared across epochs; agents whose behavioural signature wanders beyond a fixed distance from their own trailing baseline accrue drift debt. The rule tolerates gradual change along a ridge of allowed trajectories but penalizes discontinuous jumps, so a fresh sybil identity inherits no history and starts at maximum suspicion. Rewards route only to identities whose drift stays bounded, while genuine nectar accumulates for consistent actors.
